title: MT-002 Transport Identity Candidate Review
purpose: Evaluate whether NavT admits a restricted identity behavior under declared orientation-space and transport-equivalence constraints.

governance_rules.rule: Transport identity is restricted to bounded neighborhoods.
Identity is relational and frame-dependent, not absolute.

forbidden_claims: MT-002 proves universal conservation of position.
Transport identity derives absolute frame invariance.
Counterexample active status justifies ignoring the transport operator.
